display_long_description:
**You are a panda running the most chaotic ramen shop in all of Asia. 🍜**

Ingredients fly through the air, customers are hungry, and your blade is the only thing standing between a perfect bowl of tonkotsu and an absolute disaster.

**Slice the right ingredients mid-air to cook the perfect recipe! 🔪**

[media]

**Too slow and you'll miss it, too careless and you'll end up serving mystery soup to very confused customers.**

[media]

Train your eye. Trust your blade. Master every recipe one clean slice at a time.

Fast hands. Sharp blade. Hungry panda.

Become the Ramen Master. 🐼
